assembly_instructions: Chip-floorplan model of the OpenSPARC T2 (UltraSPARC T2 / Niagara 2) die with the package lid removed so every functional block is exposed from above. The ~342 mm-sq (~18.5 mm-square) silicon die is scaled up ~487x to a 9 m square plate for inspectability. Build order: (1) lay the silicon die plate as the root; (2) frame it with the 4-segment copper I/O pad / seal ring (ring_n/s/e/w); (3) drop the central CCX crossbar switch at die centre; (4) place the 8 SPARC physical cores in two rows of 4 along the +Z and -Z edges; (5) fit the 8 L2 cache banks in two rows flanking the crossbar, each bank built as a large white data array plus a smaller tan tag array facing the crossbar; (6) install the 4 FBDIMM memory controllers in the X-edge columns, each wired to its pair of L2 data arrays; (7) add the Clock Control Unit (CCU) and Test Control Unit (TCU) in the remaining edge-column slots; (8) seat the System Interface Unit (SIU) and Non-Cacheable Unit (NCU) beside the crossbar with the dual-10GbE NIU and x8 PCI-Express blocks outboard of them; (9) finally stack core_0's six exploded internal sub-units (L1 I-cache, L1 D-cache, two integer pipelines, load-store unit, FPU/graphics unit) in a 2x3 grid above the core, tied down by two thin guide posts. The other 7 cores are left as solid blocks of identical footprint.

info.japanese_name: オープンスパーク T2
info.summary: OpenSPARC T2 is the open-sourced RTL of Sun Microsystems' UltraSPARC T2 chip-multithreading SPARC V9 processor, a 65 nm system-on-a-chip carrying 8 cores and 64 hardware threads. It was the first commercial processor whose full source RTL was released under an open license.
info.description: The UltraSPARC T2, codenamed Niagara 2, integrates 8 SPARC physical cores on a single 65 nm die of roughly 342 mm sq with about 503 million transistors. Each core executes 8 hardware threads via two integer execution pipelines and a load-store unit, and carries a dedicated 16 KB L1 instruction cache, 8 KB L1 data cache, and a per-core floating-point and graphics unit — giving 64 threads in total at clock speeds up to 1.4 GHz. A central crossbar switch (CCX) connects all 8 cores to 8 banks of shared L2 cache totalling 4 MB; the L2 banks feed 4 dual-channel on-chip FBDIMM memory controllers. The chip is a true SoC, integrating a Network Interface Unit with two 10 Gigabit Ethernet ports and an x8 PCI-Express interface through a System Interface Unit, eliminating much of the support chipset. In 2008 Sun released the complete OpenSPARC T2 design — RTL, verification environment, simulation models and tool scripts — under the GNU GPL.
info.contractor: Sun Microsystems / Texas Instruments (65 nm fabrication)
info.contract_value: Open-source release — no license fee (GNU GPL v2)
info.status: Open-sourced design; UltraSPARC T2 silicon discontinued, RTL still publicly available

parts.name: Silicon die substrate
parts.role: The 65 nm, ~342 mm-sq silicon die carrying every functional block; root of the floorplan with no package lid so all blocks are visible from above.

parts.name: I/O pad / seal ring — north edge
parts.role: North run of the bond-pad and crack-stop seal ring that frames the die and routes power and signal pads to the package.

parts.name: I/O pad / seal ring — south edge
parts.role: South run of the bond-pad and crack-stop seal ring framing the die perimeter.

parts.name: I/O pad / seal ring — east edge
parts.role: East run of the bond-pad and crack-stop seal ring, carrying FBDIMM and I/O pads on the +X flank.

parts.name: I/O pad / seal ring — west edge
parts.role: West run of the bond-pad and crack-stop seal ring, carrying FBDIMM and I/O pads on the -X flank.

parts.name: SPARC core 0
parts.role: One of 8 identical SPARC physical cores; runs 8 hardware threads through two integer pipelines, a load-store unit and a per-core FPU — its interior is exploded above for inspection.

parts.name: SPARC core 1
parts.role: SPARC physical core running 8 hardware threads through two integer pipelines plus load-store and floating-point units.

parts.name: SPARC core 2
parts.role: SPARC physical core running 8 hardware threads, with private 16 KB L1 I-cache and 8 KB L1 D-cache.

parts.name: SPARC core 3
parts.role: SPARC physical core running 8 hardware threads through its integer pipelines and load-store unit.

parts.name: SPARC core 4
parts.role: SPARC physical core running 8 hardware threads; identical microarchitecture to cores 0-3.

parts.name: SPARC core 5
parts.role: SPARC physical core running 8 hardware threads with private L1 instruction and data caches.

parts.name: SPARC core 6
parts.role: SPARC physical core running 8 hardware threads through two integer pipelines and an FPU/graphics unit.

parts.name: SPARC core 7
parts.role: SPARC physical core running 8 hardware threads; eighth of the 8 cores giving 64 threads total.

parts.name: CCX cache crossbar switch
parts.role: Central non-blocking 8x9 crossbar (CCX) connecting all 8 SPARC cores to the 8 L2 tag arrays and to the SIU/NCU.

parts.name: L2 bank 0 — data array
parts.role: Data array of L2 bank 0, one eighth of the 4 MB 16-way shared L2; holds cache lines and routes misses to FBDIMM controller mcu_0.

parts.name: L2 bank 1 — data array
parts.role: Data array of L2 bank 1 holding 16-way set-associative cache lines, backed by FBDIMM controller mcu_0.

parts.name: L2 bank 2 — data array
parts.role: Data array of L2 bank 2; one eighth of the on-chip 4 MB L2, backed by FBDIMM controller mcu_2.

parts.name: L2 bank 3 — data array
parts.role: Data array of L2 bank 3 holding cache lines, backed by FBDIMM memory controller mcu_2.

parts.name: L2 bank 4 — data array
parts.role: Data array of L2 bank 4 holding 16-way cache lines, backed by FBDIMM controller mcu_1.

parts.name: L2 bank 5 — data array
parts.role: Data array of L2 bank 5; one eighth of the 4 MB L2, backed by FBDIMM controller mcu_1.

parts.name: L2 bank 6 — data array
parts.role: Data array of L2 bank 6 holding cache lines; routes misses to FBDIMM controller mcu_3.

parts.name: L2 bank 7 — data array
parts.role: Data array of L2 bank 7 completing the 4 MB on-chip L2, backed by FBDIMM controller mcu_3.

parts.name: L2 bank 0 — tag array
parts.role: Tag array of L2 bank 0; stores line tags and directory state, fielding crossbar requests and steering hits to data array l2_0.

parts.name: L2 bank 1 — tag array
parts.role: Tag array of L2 bank 1; performs the 16-way tag compare and forwards hits to data array l2_1.

parts.name: L2 bank 2 — tag array
parts.role: Tag array of L2 bank 2; resolves crossbar lookups and directs accesses into data array l2_2.

parts.name: L2 bank 3 — tag array
parts.role: Tag array of L2 bank 3; holds line tags and steers crossbar hits to data array l2_3.

parts.name: L2 bank 4 — tag array
parts.role: Tag array of L2 bank 4; performs tag compares and routes hits into data array l2_4.

parts.name: L2 bank 5 — tag array
parts.role: Tag array of L2 bank 5; stores directory state and steers crossbar accesses to data array l2_5.

parts.name: L2 bank 6 — tag array
parts.role: Tag array of L2 bank 6; resolves the 16-way tag lookup and forwards hits to data array l2_6.

parts.name: L2 bank 7 — tag array
parts.role: Tag array of L2 bank 7; holds line tags and steers crossbar hits into data array l2_7.

parts.name: FBDIMM memory controller 0
parts.role: One of 4 dual-channel FBDIMM memory controllers driving off-chip DRAM; serves L2 data arrays l2_0 and l2_1.

parts.name: FBDIMM memory controller 1
parts.role: Dual-channel FBDIMM memory controller serving L2 data arrays l2_4 and l2_5.

parts.name: FBDIMM memory controller 2
parts.role: Dual-channel FBDIMM memory controller serving L2 data arrays l2_2 and l2_3.

parts.name: FBDIMM memory controller 3
parts.role: Fourth dual-channel FBDIMM memory controller serving L2 data arrays l2_6 and l2_7.

parts.name: System Interface Unit (SIU)
parts.role: System Interface Unit that bridges the NIU and PCI-Express I/O blocks into the L2 cache through the crossbar.

parts.name: Non-Cacheable Unit (NCU)
parts.role: Non-Cacheable Unit routing programmed-I/O, interrupt and configuration-register traffic between the cores, crossbar and TCU.

parts.name: Network Interface Unit (dual 10 GbE)
parts.role: On-chip networking unit providing two 10 Gigabit Ethernet ports, feeding the L2 cache through the SIU.

parts.name: PCI-Express interface (x8)
parts.role: On-chip x8 PCI-Express interface linking the SoC to external I/O devices through the SIU.

parts.name: Clock Control Unit (CCU / PLLs)
parts.role: Clock Control Unit housing the on-die PLLs that generate and distribute the up-to-1.4 GHz core and I/O clocks.

parts.name: Test Control Unit (TCU / JTAG)
parts.role: Test Control Unit driving JTAG scan, built-in self-test and debug access across every block on the die.

parts.name: core_0 L1 instruction cache
parts.role: 16 KB private L1 instruction cache of core_0, shown in the exploded 2x3 grid directly above the core for inspectability.

parts.name: core_0 L1 data cache
parts.role: 8 KB private L1 data cache of core_0, shown above the core in the exploded view.

parts.name: core_0 integer pipeline A
parts.role: First of core_0's two integer execution pipelines, serving 4 of its 8 threads, shown in the exploded view above the core.

parts.name: core_0 integer pipeline B
parts.role: Second of core_0's two integer execution pipelines, serving the other 4 threads, shown in the exploded view.

parts.name: core_0 load-store unit
parts.role: Load-store unit of core_0 handling memory accesses for all 8 threads, shown above the core in the exploded view.

parts.name: core_0 FPU / graphics unit
parts.role: Per-core floating-point and graphics unit of core_0, shared by its 8 threads, shown in the exploded view above the core.

parts.name: core_0 explosion guide post — front
parts.role: Thin guide post tying core_0's top face to the exploded I-cache sub-unit above it, showing the explosion came straight out of this core.

parts.name: core_0 explosion guide post — rear
parts.role: Thin guide post tying core_0's top face to the exploded FPU sub-unit above it, anchoring the exploded 2x3 grid to its core.
